title: NEVER touch the cake at 3 AM

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [whispers] [high voice] My sister says... NEVER touch the cake at 3 AM.
lines.caption: My sister says NEVER touch the cake at 3 AM

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [whispers] [nervous] [high voice] She says a MONSTER guards it.
lines.caption: She says a MONSTER guards it

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [deep voice] [dramatically] WHO... DARES... touch my cake?
lines.caption: WHO DARES touch my cake?

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [screaming] [high voice] AAAH! The blanket is ALIVE!
lines.caption: AAAH! The blanket is ALIVE!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [trembling voice] [high voice] Please, mister monster... don't eat me!
lines.caption: Please mister monster don't eat me!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [deep voice] Leave the cake... and go to BED. [giggles]
lines.caption: Leave the cake and go to BED

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [curious] [high voice] Wait... why does the monster sound like DOTTIE?
lines.caption: Wait why does the monster sound like DOTTIE?

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [nervous] [high voice] Uh... hi! I'm the... cake inspector?
lines.caption: Uh hi! I'm the cake inspector?

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [shouting] [high voice] DOTTIE! You ate HALF the cake!
lines.caption: DOTTIE! You ate HALF the cake!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [whispers] [high voice] Shh! Okay, okay. You get a slice... if you don't tell Mom.
lines.caption: Shh! Okay okay You get a slice if you don't tell Mom
